en: Aerial view of a complex centered on a large pinkish‑stone church with a dome and cross-shaped floor plan, surrounded by forested hills. The church has a prominent central dome, smaller side domes, and a broad stairway. Nearby are red‑tiled-roof buildings, including what appears to be a multi‑arched guesthouse or monastery building. The landscape is mountainous and lush, and the image has the slightly faded colors typical of printed postcards from the late 20th century. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
